# Chicco KeyFit 30 ClearTex (US)

- **Id:** `chicco-keyfit-30-cleartex`
- **Category:** car-seat
- **Status:** rejected
- **Price:** $229.99
- **Brand:** Chicco
- **Maker's page:** <https://www.chiccousa.com/shop-our-products/car-seats/infant/keyfit-30-cleartex-infant-car-seat---pewter/05087002560070.html>
- **Decision:** [ADR 0004: Buy the UPPAbaby Aria V2 infant car seat](../../decisions/0004-buy-the-uppababy-aria-v2.md)

## Summary

The cheapest and narrowest seat on the shortlist ([market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)), and the only one tested in a Model Y ([Cars.com](https://www.cars.com/articles/how-do-car-seats-fit-in-a-2021-tesla-model-y-436721), 2021 car, grade A). Its base has no load leg, and the [manual](https://www.chiccousa.com/on/demandware.static/-/Sites-chicco_catalog/default/dwce771062/images/products/Manuals/car-seats/Chicco-KeyFit-30-Car-Seat-Product-Manual-03-2020.pdf) allows no towel under the base if the bubble cannot reach the level range. No review tested the current 213a-labeled unit ([keyfit-30 usability note](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-chicco-keyfit-30-usability.md)).

## Safety

- **Standards:** FMVSS 213, FMVSS 213a, FMVSS 213b
- **FMVSS 213a (decision 0001):** recorded
- **Recall search last run:** 2026-11-27
- **Recalls:** none found in the search of 2026-11-27

## Pros

- Only seat with a Model Y test - Cars.com grade A in a 2021 Model Y, "fit easily" ([market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)).
- Narrowest carrier in the survey, 16.75 in by the maker ([market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)).
- Lowest price on the shortlist, $229.99; extra base $134.99 ([market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)).
- Easy base install with a readable recline foot and bubble levels ([CSFTL](https://csftl.org/chicco-keyfit-30-review/), [BabyGearLab](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/chicco-keyfit-30), [CR](https://www.consumerreports.org/babies-kids/car-seats/chicco-keyfit-30/m90195/) agree; base shared across versions).
- Consumer Reports overall 86, 6th of 46 infant seats, with 5/5 fit for both LATCH and seat belt installs; the version CR tested is not stated ([read through Nick's CR account](https://www.consumerreports.org/babies-kids/car-seats/chicco-keyfit-30/m90195/)).
- Widest third-party adapter coverage of the shortlist (Thule, Bugaboo Fox/Buffalo, Mockingbird, all Chicco strollers but two) ([market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)).

## Cons

Misuse risks come first.

- **Misuse risk:** NHTSA ease-of-use rates its labels 1 star - no harness slot height marking, no LATCH illustrations ([NHTSA](https://api.nhtsa.gov/childSeats?dataSet=ratings&max=100&offset=0), unit made 2026-03-01). Overall 3 stars.
- **Misuse risk:** no click-in indicator; a correct latch depends on hearing the click and lifting the carrier every time ([BabyGearLab](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/chicco-keyfit-30), [manual](https://www.chiccousa.com/on/demandware.static/-/Sites-chicco_catalog/default/dwce771062/images/products/Manuals/car-seats/Chicco-KeyFit-30-Car-Seat-Product-Manual-03-2020.pdf)).
- **Misuse risk:** caregivers often use both lock-offs at once; the manual allows only the one opposite the buckle ([CSFTL](https://csftl.org/chicco-keyfit-30-review/)).
- **Misuse risk:** harness height needs rethreading at the splitter plate; a strap can be left twisted or unhooked ([manual](https://www.chiccousa.com/on/demandware.static/-/Sites-chicco_catalog/default/dwce771062/images/products/Manuals/car-seats/Chicco-KeyFit-30-Car-Seat-Product-Manual-03-2020.pdf) warning; [NHTSA](https://api.nhtsa.gov/childSeats?dataSet=ratings&max=100&offset=0) notes the rethread).
- Baseless install is American or lap-only, no European routing, and felt "wobbly in both test cars" ([BabyGearLab](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/chicco-keyfit-30)); [CR](https://www.consumerreports.org/babies-kids/car-seats/chicco-keyfit-30/m90195/) carrier-only 3/5.
- No towel or noodle allowed under the base; if the foot cannot reach the angle, the base cannot be used in that seat ([manual](https://www.chiccousa.com/on/demandware.static/-/Sites-chicco_catalog/default/dwce771062/images/products/Manuals/car-seats/Chicco-KeyFit-30-Car-Seat-Product-Manual-03-2020.pdf)).
- LATCH tightening "takes a fair amount of effort" ([The Bump](https://www.thebump.com/a/chicco-keyfit-30-infant-car-seat-review), one parent, 2020 unit before ClearTex). Low confidence.
- Small canopy ([several reviewers agree](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-chicco-keyfit-30-usability.md)); one crotch position, three harness heights.
- 30 in height limit; 6-year expiry, the shortest on the shortlist ([manual](https://www.chiccousa.com/on/demandware.static/-/Sites-chicco_catalog/default/dwce771062/images/products/Manuals/car-seats/Chicco-KeyFit-30-Car-Seat-Product-Manual-03-2020.pdf); [market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)).
